show.description: Rishi, the hidden founder of aerospace giant Pankh, lives as a poor mechanic for his family, who see him as a failure. Betrayed and humiliated, he reveals his true identity and rises to global success. Now, his wife and daughter must face regret for losing the man they never valued.
